ProxyPiTester v1.0.0
====================
https://proxypi.co.uk

UK residential SOCKS5 / HTTP proxy connectivity + speed test tool.

HOW TO USE
----------
1. Double-click ProxyPiTester.exe
2. Enter your node host, port, username and password
3. Click "Test Proxy" for exit IP + latency
4. Click "Speed Test" for download throughput (Mbps)

MENUS
-----
File  > Exit
Help  > Check for Updates...   (compares with public GitHub update feed)
Help  > Visit Website
Help  > About ProxyPiTester

Save / Reload stores settings next to the EXE as ProxyPiTester.ini
(only on your PC — this download package does not include any credentials).

UPDATES
-------
The app can check a public update.json / GitHub Release for a newer version.
No passwords or GitHub tokens are stored in the EXE.

REQUIREMENTS
------------
- Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
- Network access to your proxy node and the public test endpoints

SUPPORT
-------
https://proxypi.co.uk
